scope: Existing completed synthetic study integration. No new campaign, trajectory reduction, physical test or acceptance change.
raw_trajectory_scope: Only the existing complete trajectory-readback result and original trace hashes are in Git. Full trajectories remain in the local archive; a scalar reader is not independent scientific reproduction.
recorded_software: Executed Python version is retained in progress.json. No dependency lock was reconstructed or updated after outcomes.
approval: Local source-review candidate; parent owns review, contributor checks and any commit/publication. No Claude formal approval or CLOSED state.
adaptation_record: The public diff redacts the original host path and is not byte-exact or directly applicable. Exact source hashes remain registered; the exact diff and original study source stay private.
